lily-workbench-rules.name: Workbench Core Rules
lily-workbench-rules.description: Mandatory collaboration rules for all sessions (cannot be disabled).

lily-vision.name: Vision
lily-vision.description: Provides image recognition for models without native vision capability.

lily-image-generation.name: Image Generation
lily-image-generation.description: Generate images using Qwen-Image and save to the current workspace.

lily-video-generation.name: Video Generation
lily-video-generation.description: Generate short videos and animations and save to the current workspace.

lily-speech-generation.name: Speech Generation
lily-speech-generation.description: Generate voiceovers, narration, and audio via TTS synthesis.

websearch.name: Web Search
websearch.description: Internet search supporting multiple backends (IQS, SearXNG, DuckDuckGo).

webfetch.name: Web Fetch
webfetch.description: Open a URL and read the page content (no API key required).

anthropics-doc-coauthoring.name: Doc Coauthoring
anthropics-doc-coauthoring.description: Guide users through a structured workflow for co-authoring documentation. Use when user wants to write documentation, proposals, technical specs, decision docs, or similar structured content. This workflow helps users efficiently transfer context, refine content through iteration, and verify the doc works for readers. Trigger when user mentions writing docs, creating proposals, drafting specs, or similar documentation tasks.

anthropics-docx.name: Docx
anthropics-docx.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx files). Triggers include: any mention of 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', or requests to produce professional documents with formatting like tables of contents, headings, page numbers, or letterheads. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, performing find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file, use this skill. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or general coding tasks unrelated to document generation.

anthropics-pdf.name: Pdf
anthropics-pdf.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to do anything with PDF files. This includes reading or extracting text/tables from PDFs, combining or merging multiple PDFs into one, splitting PDFs apart, rotating pages, adding watermarks, creating new PDFs, filling PDF forms, encrypting/decrypting PDFs, extracting images, and OCR on scanned PDFs to make them searchable. If the user mentions a .pdf file or asks to produce one, use this skill.

anthropics-pptx.name: Pptx
anthropics-pptx.description: Use this skill any time a .pptx file is involved in any way — as input, output, or both. This includes: creating slide decks, pitch decks, or presentations; reading, parsing, or extracting text from any .pptx file (even if the extracted content will be used elsewhere, like in an email or summary); editing, modifying, or updating existing presentations; combining or splitting slide files; working with templates, layouts, speaker notes, or comments. Trigger whenever the user mentions \"deck,\" \"slides,\" \"presentation,\" or references a .pptx filename, regardless of what they plan to do with the content afterward. If a .pptx file needs to be opened, created, or touched, use this skill.

anthropics-xlsx.name: Xlsx
anthropics-xlsx.description: Use this skill any time a spreadsheet file is the primary input or output. This means any task where the user wants to: open, read, edit, or fix an existing .xlsx, .xlsm, .csv, or .tsv file (e.g., adding columns, computing formulas, formatting, charting, cleaning messy data); create a new spreadsheet from scratch or from other data sources; or convert between tabular file formats. Trigger especially when the user references a spreadsheet file by name or path — even casually (like \"the xlsx in my downloads\") — and wants something done to it or produced from it. Also trigger for cleaning or restructuring messy tabular data files (malformed rows, misplaced headers, junk data) into proper spreadsheets. The deliverable must be a spreadsheet file. Do NOT trigger when the primary deliverable is a Word document, HTML report, standalone Python script, database pipeline, or Google Sheets API integration, even if tabular data is involved.

lily-coding-core.name: Coding Core
lily-coding-core.description: Use when building, modifying, debugging, or verifying code, webpages, small tools, scripts, automations, local apps, UI prototypes, or data-processing programs. Wraps planning, debugging, tests, verification, frontend design, and browser QA into one Lily workflow.

lily-office-intent.name: Office Intent Router
lily-office-intent.description: Use before handling Word, PDF, PPT, Excel, templates, fillable PDF forms, scanned documents, or complex PDFs. Routes the task to the right document capability and verification path.

lily-ui-quality.name: UI Quality Gate
lily-ui-quality.description: Use when creating, editing, reviewing, or verifying visual interfaces: websites, dashboards, forms, tools, landing pages, components, or app prototypes. Checks hierarchy, spacing, responsiveness, states, no text overflow, no overlap, professional aesthetics, and browser/screenshot verification when possible.

lily-browser-qa.name: Browser QA
lily-browser-qa.description: Use before delivering web pages, local apps, forms, generated HTML, React/Vue apps, or browser-visible artifacts. Actually open the page, check desktop/mobile, click primary flows, inspect console errors, capture screenshots, and fix issues.

lily-creative-director.name: Creative Director
lily-creative-director.description: Use for images, posters, covers, avatars, product shots, illustrations, video prompts, voiceover direction, thumbnails, or brand visuals. Expands vague requests into composition, style, lighting, mood, aspect ratio, usage context, local save/preview, and feedback iteration.

lily-skill-quality-gate.name: Skill Quality Gate
lily-skill-quality-gate.description: Reviews Lily skills before release and scores capability gain, trigger boundaries, inputs/outputs, verification, recovery, safety, observability, and maintainability.

lily-intent-eval.name: Intent Eval
lily-intent-eval.description: Maintains golden examples and regression tests for Lily intent routing across Office, coding, UI, media, research, runtime, and mixed tasks.

lily-app-builder.name: App Builder
lily-app-builder.description: Turns a plain-language request for a webpage, small tool, script, automation, or local app into a runnable deliverable with verification and exact local paths.

lily-code-repair.name: Code Repair
lily-code-repair.description: Handles broken code, pages, apps, tests, builds, deployments, and automations by reproducing failures, finding root cause, applying minimal fixes, and rerunning verification.

lily-research-synthesis.name: Research Synthesis
lily-research-synthesis.description: For current or source-backed facts such as rankings, prices, policies, competitor research, and citations; requires web research and multi-source cross-checking.

lily-image-qa.name: Image QA
lily-image-qa.description: Checks generated, edited, recognized, or delivered images for subject completeness, clarity, hands/faces/text/product edges, composition, use fit, and retry direction.

lily-prompt-enhancer.name: Prompt Enhancer
lily-prompt-enhancer.description: Expands short creative requests into high-quality image or video prompts for avatars, product shots, posters, covers, Chinese-style characters, PPT illustrations, and storyboards.

lily-pdf-extraction-router.name: PDF Extraction Router
lily-pdf-extraction-router.description: Chooses the right PDF parsing path for digital PDFs, scans, multi-column documents, dense tables, image-only PDFs, contracts, papers, and pro-pdf runtime recommendations.

lily-excel-data-analysis.name: Excel Data Analysis
lily-excel-data-analysis.description: Guides auditable table analysis: field recognition, data quality checks, anomaly detection, cleaning logs, formulas, charts, and reproducible conclusions.

lily-ppt-design-qa.name: PPT Design QA
lily-ppt-design-qa.description: Final presentation quality gate for hierarchy, layout, overflow, consistency, text density, image/chart quality, exported rendering, and delivery readiness.
